description.value: Hui Flavor is a halal Chinese restaurant located in a unit at 4429 Kingsway in Burnaby, operating out of the space formerly occupied by TerraCotta Boyz. The restaurant offers indoor seating in a wheelchair-accessible space with a no-smoking environment. Cyclists riding the Kingsway corridor will find it a convenient stop for a sit-down halal Chinese meal.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (8 spaces, covered) at 75m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL points to an Instagram profile, but the fetched content returned only Instagram's generic login wall and boilerplate pages — no restaurant-specific content was accessible. All amenity fields therefore rely solely on OSM tags, which confirm a halal Chinese restaurant with indoor seating, no outdoor seating, and wheelchair access (check_date 2025-10-04). The OSM 'was:name' tags indicate the business recently rebranded from 'TerraCotta Boyz' / '秦俑厨坊' to 'Hui Flavor'.
